description: This file defines a service class 'QualifiedHostsService' that determines qualified hosts for bookings based on various filtering criteria, including delegation credentials, event segments, and fallback logic. It includes helper functions and interfaces related to host filtering and selection within a booking system.

classes.name: QualifiedHostsService
classes.description: A service class responsible for determining qualified hosts for booking events, considering delegation credentials, host filtering, and fallback strategies.

methods.name: _findQualifiedHostsWithDelegationCredentials
methods.description: Asynchronously finds and filters hosts based on event type, delegation credentials, segment matching, contact owner, routed team members, and lead thresholds, returning qualified hosts and fallback options.

methods.name: findQualifiedHostsWithDelegationCredentials
methods.description: Wrapped version of the internal method with reporting, used externally to get qualified hosts with delegation credentials.
